11wbxt: Original SpanishCue material; the situations and data are for teaching, not real news or official exam texts.
ihc406: Document A. The Horizonte cooperative opened its dining hall before the reservation system was ready. The April minutes record that the management expected the program to work in early June. In a later circular, that expectation became the claim that it would work for the opening. There is, however, no message from the technical company guaranteeing that date. During the first week several reservations were duplicated and three groups had to wait more than an hour.
17qsdkd: Document B. The floor manager wrote to the members: «I'm sorry that you had to wait, and I appreciate that the team found alternative tables». She added that, if the management had announced a trial opening, fewer reservations would have been accepted. Her email drew criticism because some people interpreted it as an accusation against those who had worked to open on time. She clarified that she was not questioning their effort, but the transformation of a forecast into a public promise.
m7bhux: Document C. The chair acknowledges that she could have asked for written confirmation, although she points out that the supplier also knew the opening date. She proposes offering compensation to the affected groups and keeping the dining hall open with phone reservations. The technical company asks that the program's features be temporarily reduced so it can finish the essential part. The floor staff accept that provisional system as long as they do not have to handle the phone and the tables at the same time.
1c5jsw: The next assembly will have to decide what is communicated to customers and how the additional work is distributed. An explanation that only looks for culprits would leave immediate needs unresolved. But a message that merely celebrates the ability to react would not answer the pending questions either. Mediation consists of keeping that double demand: acknowledging the effort and asking for accountability, without inventing guarantees that no one can yet offer.
amju14: Attention annex. In an internal survey, sixteen of the twenty-four groups served that week responded. Nine rated the food positively; seven pointed out difficulties with the reservation. Some responses included both observations, so they should not be added up as mutually exclusive categories. The survey was sent after a compensation was offered and does not show how those who did not respond would have answered. The team proposes using it to detect aspects to review, without presenting it as a definitive measure of satisfaction.
p60tje: The committee has a limited budget: it can hire phone support for two weeks or fund a campaign to win back customers, but not both at the same time. The first option addresses the operational problem; the second could increase demand before it is solved. Those who defend the campaign argue that without income the support cannot be sustained either. The final recommendation must explain that tension and anticipate what will be done if the number of reservations exceeds the capacity of the provisional system.
